extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycles 1-2: Days 1, 8, 15, 22; Cycles 3-6: Days 1, 15; Cycles 7+: Day 1

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Radiation: Daily (5 days/week) for 6 weeks. Maintenance Regimen A (6-week cycles): Days 1, 8, 15. Maintenance Regimen B (4-week cycles): Days 1, 2, 8, 15.
assumptions: Screening assessments (pre-op and post-op MRIs, labs, audiogram) are completed over 2 unique calendar days.
Radiation therapy (RT) consists of 30 fractions delivered over 6 weeks (5 days per week).
The 18 Gy CSI arm receives an additional 3 days of posterior fossa radiation to reach the same total boost dose as the standard arm, resulting in identical total RT visit counts.
A single clinic visit for endocrine evaluation is required during the 4-week rest period following RT.
Maintenance Regimen B requires a lab visit on Day 15 for weekly CBC monitoring, in addition to chemo visits on Days 1, 2, and 8.
All other required assessments (imaging, labs, audiograms) occur on scheduled treatment days and are assigned to the core_treatment category.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Radiation: Daily (5 days/week) for 6 weeks. Maintenance Regimen A (6-week cycles): Days 1, 8, 15. Maintenance Regimen B (4-week cycles): Days 1, 2, 8, 15.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: C1D1, C1D14, C2D1, C2D14, then every 3 cycles (C3D1, C6D1, C9D1, C12D1...)
assumptions: Screening is counted as 1 unique calendar day for mandatory labs and assessments.
Visits 2 and 4 (C1D14 and C2D14) are counted as in-person contact days for Arm A because safety laboratory testing at the research center is mandatory per protocol note 'v'.
All in-person visits include mandatory blood draws (Hematology/Chemistry), so they are categorized as 'labs' days per the priority rules.
Core treatment is 0 because Palbociclib and Endocrine Therapy are oral medications self-administered at home, not clinic-based administrations or infusions.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: C1D1, C2D1, C3D1, then every 3 cycles (C6D1, C9D1, C12D1...)

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: RVD Cycles 1-8: Days 1, 4, 8, 11 (4 visits/cycle). Maintenance: Day 1 dosing visit + weekly/bi-weekly labs in early cycles.
assumptions: Screening is estimated as 1 unique calendar day for imaging and labs.

Maintenance therapy starts approximately at Month 7 after 8 cycles of RVD and mobilization.
Maintenance lab visits (D8, D15, D22) are counted as unique 'labs' contact days when they do not coincide with dosing visits.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: RVD Cycles 1-3 & 4-5: Days 1, 4, 8, 11. Transplant: ~20 days inpatient. Maintenance: Day 1 dosing visit + weekly/bi-weekly labs in early cycles.
assumptions: Screening is estimated as 1 unique calendar day.

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Day 1, Day 8, Day 15. Subsequent cycles: Day 1.
assumptions: Screening consists of two distinct visits: Tissue Screening (biopsy/labs) and Main Screening (imaging/diagnostics).
Day 1 visits for all cycles include drug administration (core_treatment), which takes priority over imaging (tumor assessments every 6 weeks) and labs (PK/ADA) occurring on the same day.
Cycle 1 Day 8 and Day 15 visits are for labs and vital signs only (no infusion).
12-month window includes 18 cycles (365 days / 21 days = 17.38 cycles).

extraction_notes.visit_pattern: Cycle 1: Day 1, Day 8, Day 15. Subsequent cycles: Day 1.
assumptions: TPC arm follows the study-defined 21-day cycle Schedule of Assessments (SoA) as the master schedule for protocol-mandated contacts.

Although some TPC drugs (e.g., Gemcitabine) have infusions on Day 8/15 of every cycle, the SoA table only mandates Day 8/15 visits for Cycle 1; therefore, only Cycle 1 Day 8/15 are counted as healthcare contact days per the extraction rules.
